scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: The University of the South Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Institutional Research)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 4,555 applied, 2,570 admitted (56.4%), 454 enrolled; the residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International first-years: 1,581 applied, 130 admitted (8.2%), 20 enrolled. SAT submitted by 24% (111 students) and ACT by 36% (164) of enrolled first-years. Sewanee does not report high-school GPA (C11/C12 say 'High school GPA data is not reported'), so no GPA figures are shown. The early decision counts (248 applied, 176 admitted) sit under a line the form prints as 'For the Fall 2024 entering class'; they are shown as printed. Undergraduate enrollment (1,590) and the nonresident count (68) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures (B1/B2); degree-seeking nonresident undergraduates are 67.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs from the Common Data Set, whose G1 table is headed 'FULL 2026-2027 academic year': tuition $60,088, required fees $320 (the activities fee), food and housing $17,272 (housing $8,940 + meals $8,332). Estimated expenses (G5): books and supplies $800, transportation $1,200, other $1,200 (other shown = transportation + other). Sewanee's 2026-27 tuition page prints a comprehensive fee of $78,210 'includes tuition, fees, books, room and your meal plan' (its catalog lists a $530 'First Day Complete' bookstore program that can be opted out of). For international students Sewanee says to 'budget roughly $6,000 for necessary supplies, health insurance, personal expenses, SEVIS, visa expenses and travel'. The college's own need-based and non-need-based aid is available to nonresidents (CDS H6): 57 nonresident undergraduates received it, $3,622,890 in total, average $63,559.
